name: file-content-extraction
label: File Content Extraction
description: Utility to Extract Text, Artifacts and Metadata from almost any file. Internet connectivity is required for the connector to download dependent packages

operations.description: Extracts text and metadata from file based on the file IRI/path that you have specified.
operations.title: Extract Text

parameters.title: File IRI/Path
parameters.description: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment or an indicator. NOTE: The file name is taken from the tmp directory.
parameters.name: file_iri
parameters.tooltip: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment or an indicator. NOTE: The file name is taken from the tmp directory.

parameters.title: Set Output Format to XHTML
parameters.description: Select to format the extracted text in XHTML
parameters.name: html_output_format
parameters.tooltip: Select to format the extracted text in XHTML

operations.description: Extracts artifacts from file based on the file IRI/path that you have specified. This action utilizes regex for IOC extraction.
operations.title: Extract Artifacts

parameters.title: File IRI/Path
parameters.description: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment or an indicator. NOTE: The file name is taken from the /tmp directory.
parameters.name: file_iri
parameters.tooltip: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment or an indicator. NOTE: The file name is taken from the /tmp directory.

operations.description: Extracts artifacts from file based on the file IRI/path that you have specified. This action uses a Python library for indicators extraction from various file formats.
operations.title: Extract Artifacts Extended

parameters.title: File IRI/Path
parameters.description: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment.
parameters.name: file_iri
parameters.tooltip: Specify the file IRI/path where the file is located. File IRI is an attribute of a file which is in turn an attribute of an attachment.

operations.description: Get extraction backend configuration details based on the file IRI/path that you have specified.
operations.title: Get Backend Config
Create XLSX File as Attachment From JSON Data
operations.description: Creates XLSX file as attachment from JSON Data provided.

parameters.title: File Name
parameters.name: fileName
parameters.tooltip: Specify a name of the file to create.
parameters.description: Specify the file name to create.

parameters.title: JSON Data
parameters.name: jsonData
parameters.tooltip: Provide uniform JSON Data to be converted to XLSX file.
parameters.description: Provide uniform JSON Data to be converted to XLSX file.

parameters.title: XLSX Fields
parameters.name: xLSXFields
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Provide comma-separated column names to include in the XLSX file. Leave blank to include all columns.
